description: Custom devices in Iraq collected 3,589 records during one week for paddy and barley irrigation. Variables include soil and air conditions, crop type and irrigation on-off status. This resource is provided by ZAMEER AHMAD. Coverage is site as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence: CC BY 4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The short experiment does not establish seasonal representativeness or device accuracy outside the study. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-iiasa-cwatm-community-water-model. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
